Story

📖

Hikoyani 3 marta o‘qing: avval jim, keyin audio bilan, keyin ovoz chiqarib.

A Sunday with my big family

🎧 Track 1.2 · StoryScan & listen

My name is Dilnoza and I live in Samarkand with my parents and my little brother. I’m not an only child, but sometimes I feel like one because my brother is ten years younger!

Every Sunday, all our relatives get together at my grandparents’ house. My grandma is very kind and calm. She looks after everyone and cooks a huge plov. My grandpa is a bit strict, but he is also really funny.

My aunt comes with her husband and their twins, Ali and Vali. They are my favourite cousins. I get on well with them because we grew up together. My uncle and his wife bring my niece, little Madina. Everyone says she looks like me!

My grandparents are very proud. They have five grandsons and three granddaughters. My parents got married twenty years ago, and they are still very close. My dad is a hard-working engineer.

I love Sundays because our family is loud, happy and full of love.

🔁 Read it 3 times: 1 · silently2 · with the audio3 · aloud, alone

    Men eng kattasiman / eng kichigiman.

    Dadam … bo‘lib ishlaydi.
  • Everyone says I look like …
    Hamma meni …ga o‘xshaydi deydi.
  • I’m closest to my …
    Men …ga eng yaqinman.
  • We sometimes argue, but …
    Ba’zan tortishamiz, lekin …

Answer the Questions

❓

Har bir savolga 2–3 gap bilan ovoz chiqarib javob bering.

  • 1How many people are there in your family?
  • 2Who do you look like in your family?
  • 3Who are you closest to? Why?
  • 4Do you get on well with your brothers and sisters?
  • 5Do you have a big or a small family?
  • 6How often do you see your relatives?
  • 7What do you do together at the weekend?
  • 8Who is the funniest person in your family?
⭐ Answer + reason + example. Javob + sabab (because…) + misol (for example…).

Sample answers

💡 Who are you closest to? Why?

I’m closest to my mum. She’s very kind and she always listens to me. When I have a problem, I talk to her first.

💡 How often do you see your relatives?

Quite often! Every Sunday our relatives get together at my grandparents’ house. We eat plov and talk for hours.

👥 Ask a partnerSherigingizga 3 ta savol bering va javobini yozing.

Real Speaking

🎤

Bu sizning sahnangiz! Nutqni 4 xil qahramon bo‘lib ayting.

🎬 Model speech
🎧 Track 1.3 · SpeechScan & listen

Good morning! I’d like to tell you about my family. There are five of us: my parents, my two younger sisters and me. I’m the oldest. My dad works as an engineer and my mum is a teacher. Everyone says I look like my dad – we’re both tall and calm. I get on well with my sisters, but we sometimes argue about the TV! I’m closest to my mum because she’s so kind. At the weekend we usually visit our grandparents and all our relatives get together. Family is very important to me. Thank you!

🎭 Say it 4 ways — tick each one you do

  • 😊

  • 😎

  • 🔥
    CoachMotivatsion murabbiydek — baland va ilhomli.
